name: Low-Volatility Tilt — EM Equity
description: Ranks emerging market equity assets by trailing total volatility and tilts toward lowest-vol half, zero-weights highest-vol half. Uses equal-weight weighting within held set. Implements Blitz & van Vliet (2007) — low-volatility assets earn higher risk-adjusted returns than high-volatility assets. Applied to EM equity class for focused volatility harvesting.
